vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk where you show and explain something to a group
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل: present (يقدّم) والنبر على المقطع الثاني في الفعل
vocabulary.note_en: Verb: present (stress on the second part: pre-SENT).
vocabulary.example: I have to give a presentation to the managers on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to show and explain something to a group of people
vocabulary.example: Today she will present the new product to our clients.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the people who watch or listen to a talk
vocabulary.example: The audience asked many good questions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room in an office used for meetings
vocabulary.example: Everyone is waiting in the meeting room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.example: I'd like you to meet my colleagues from the sales team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the machines and tools you need for a job
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: لا نقول equipments
vocabulary.example: All the equipment has been set up for you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to prepare and put things ready to use
vocabulary.example: Can you set up the projector before the meeting?

vocabulary.meaning_en: one page or picture in a computer presentation
vocabulary.example: This slide shows our sales for last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: ready because you planned carefully
vocabulary.example: You're well prepared, so don't worry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: arranged in a clear order
vocabulary.example: Your talk should be clearly organised.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having clear parts in a good order
vocabulary.example: Her opening was clear and well-structured.

vocabulary.meaning_en: completely new and very different
vocabulary.example: The company has a revolutionary new design.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a new event or change in a company or situation
vocabulary.example: I'll tell you about some new developments at our company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to ask a company to sell and send you goods
vocabulary.example: We hope they will place an order after the presentation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell people your name and who you are
vocabulary.example: First, introduce yourself and say which company you are from.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start talking about the next topic
vocabulary.example: Now let's move on to the costs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to introduce the last point
vocabulary.example: And finally, you can ask questions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: from a very short distance
vocabulary.example: You can see the product close up after the talk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a little afraid or worried
vocabulary.example: I always feel nervous before I speak in public.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give all your attention to one thing
vocabulary.example: Breathe deeply and focus on your first sentence.

fine_lines.title: I'm going to vs I'll
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في افتتاح العرض نستخدم I'm going to لنعلن الخطة العامة التي أعددناها مسبقًا، ونستخدم I'll لترتيب الخطوات (I'll start by). كلاهما يعبّر عن المستقبل ومقبول هنا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In an opening, "I'm going to" announces the plan you made before. "I'll" is often used for the steps: "I'll start by...". Both talk about the future and both are fine here.

examples.sentence: Today I'm going to talk about our new office.
I'll start by showing you some numbers.

fine_lines.title: first / then / finally
fine_lines.explanation_ar: هذه كلمات ترتيب: I'll start by للجزء الأول، ثم then أو move on to للجزء الأوسط، ثم finally للجزء الأخير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: These words give order: "I'll start by" for part one, "then / move on to" for the middle, and "finally" for the last part.

examples.sentence: I'll start by explaining the problem.
Then I'm going to move on to the solution.
And finally, I'll answer your questions.

expressions.meaning_en: used to introduce yourself at the start
expressions.example: Good morning. My name is Sara and I work in sales.

expressions.meaning_en: used to say what the talk is about
expressions.example: Today I'm going to present our plans for next year.

expressions.meaning_en: used to say what the first part is
expressions.example: I'll start by telling you a little about our team.

expressions.phrase: Then I'm going to move on to discuss...
expressions.meaning_en: used to introduce the next part
expressions.example: Then I'm going to move on to discuss the budget.

expressions.meaning_en: used to introduce the last part
expressions.example: And finally, there will be time for questions.

expressions.phrase: I'm very happy to be here.
expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to start a talk
expressions.example: Thank you for inviting me. I'm very happy to be here.

expressions.meaning_en: used to start the main part of the talk
expressions.example: So, let's begin with the first slide.

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to show someone where to go
expressions.example: Hello, welcome. Please come this way.

grammar.title: Future plans: be going to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + going to + الفعل الأساسي للحديث عن خطة قررناها مسبقًا. في العروض: Today I'm going to + فعل. لاحظ أن الفعل بعد to يكون في صيغته الأصلية.
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + going to + base verb for a plan you made before. In talks: "Today I'm going to + verb". The verb after "to" is in its base form.
examples: Today I'm going to explain our new product.
Then we're going to look at the prices.
She is going to present the results.

grammar.title: start by + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد حرف الجر by نضع الفعل مع ing. نقول: I'll start by telling وليس I'll start by tell.
grammar.explanation_en: After the preposition "by" we use verb + -ing: "I'll start by telling...", not "start by tell".
examples: I'll start by introducing my team.
Let's start by looking at this chart.
She started by thanking everyone for coming.

questions.question: Which phrase is best to say what your presentation is about?
questions.explanation_ar: Today I'm going to... تُعلن موضوع العرض.
questions.explanation_en: "Today I'm going to..." tells the audience the topic.

questions.question: Complete: I'll start ___ telling you about our company.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح: start by + فعل ing.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I'll start by explain the plan.
I'll start by explaining the plan.
I'll start by to explain the plan.
I'll start by explained the plan.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد by يأتي الفعل بصيغة ing.

questions.question: What does "audience" mean?
choices: the people who listen to a talk
questions.explanation_en: "Audience" means the people listening or watching.

questions.question: Which phrase introduces the LAST part of a talk?
Complete: Then I'm going to move ___ to discuss the prices.
questions.explanation_ar: move on to تعني ينتقل إلى الموضوع التالي.
questions.explanation_en: "Move on to" means go to the next topic.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Today I going to present our results.
Today I'm go to present our results.
Today I'm going to present our results.
Today I'm going present our results.
questions.explanation_ar: الصيغة: I'm + going to + الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: The form is "I'm + going to + base verb".

questions.question: "All the equipment has been ___ up so you can begin."
questions.explanation_en: "Set up" means prepare things ready to use.

questions.question: Why should you explain how your talk is organised at the start?
choices: So the audience knows what to expect
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف أن يعرف الجمهور ماذا سيسمع.
questions.explanation_en: It helps the audience know what they will hear.

questions.question: Which word is uncountable?
questions.explanation_ar: equipment اسم غير معدود فلا نقول equipments.
